territories.name: The street protest
territories.description: Wheat-pasted posters and painted walls: heavy capitals on pink and black, a marker stroke over the top.

muse.name: a protest placard
muse.take: a few heavy words you can read from across a street (F38)
muse.leave: crude production; the system is exact (F41)

signature.reason: F41 sets words in hard-edged boxes, so every corner stays square, as a placard does in the street protest territory

rationale.grounding.primary: Inferred, not stated by the source. Departs from the canon's outlines: the blocks are filled.
rationale.type.faces: Stand-ins. Quasimoda Heavy and Raleway (F38, F39) are outside the catalogue; Work Sans at 900 and Manrope are the closest in kind. The deck's headlines are uppercase, which the schema can't set.
rationale.adaptivity: headlines work on black and inverted (F42)
rationale.color.anchors.2: F33, printed HEX; the heritage color.
